title.quote: Félix G. Harvey, Mike Yurick, Derek Nowrouzezahrai, and Christopher Pal. 2020. Robust Motion In-betweening.

analysis.description: This paper presents a novel transition generation technique for 3D animators using adversarial recurrent neural networks. The proposed system synthesizes high-quality motions from temporally-sparse keyframes and evaluates its performance on in-betweening benchmarks using the Human3.6M and LaFAN1 datasets.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments using datasets and presents quantitative results to evaluate the proposed transition generation technique.
type.quote: We present well-defined in-betweening benchmarks on a subset of the widely used Human3.6M dataset and on LaFAN1, a novel high quality motion capture dataset that is more appropriate for transition generation.
